title: RS_BandPath
description: >
  Returns the URI of an out-of-database (out-db) raster band's first chunk:
  the external file the band references.
kernels:
  - returns: utf8
    args: [raster]
---

## Description

An out-db band stores a grid of chunk references instead of pixels; each chunk
names an object, or a byte range of one. `RS_BandPath` returns the `uri` of the
band's first chunk. For a band that `RS_FromPath` created, that is the source
file, with the source band selected by the band's codecs rather than by the
path. Returns null for an in-db band, whose pixels live in the raster itself.

## Examples

```sql
SELECT RS_BandPath(RS_Example());
```
